channel.title: Words | Peter Tumulty
channel.description: Writing on software engineering, AI enablement, and modernization.

item.title: Wrap Your Component in Battle Armor with React Testing Library and TypeScript
item.description: Learn how to combine React Testing Library with TypeScript to write robust component tests that catch real bugs and stay resilient through code changes.

item.title: The Pieces That Make Up Browser Caching
item.description: A practical breakdown of HTTP caching headers—Cache-Control, ETags, and Vary—and how they work together to make the web fast.

item.title: A Light Introduction to Web Components
item.description: Web Components let you build reusable UI elements that work in any framework—or none at all. Here's how the three core APIs fit together.

item.title: Adding GraphQL to Your Skill List
item.description: GraphQL solves the over-fetching and under-fetching problems of REST by letting clients request exactly the data shape they need. Here's how to get started.

item.title: Avoiding the Global Scope with the Revealing Module Pattern
item.description: The Revealing Module Pattern gives you private state and a clean public API in plain JavaScript—no build tools or classes required.

item.title: The Power of the Map Method
item.description: Array.map() is one of JavaScript's most useful methods. Learn how it works, when to use it, and how it pairs with other array methods to write clean, declarative code.
